test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rakesh rented out an amount to Samarth for 6 years at simple interest rate. At the end of the 6th year, Samarth paid (8)/(7) of the amount to Rakesh to clear out the amount. The rate of simple interest per annum was:
solution:
**Given:**

Time (t) = 6 years

Amount paid by Samarth = (8)/(7) of the principal

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times R times T)/(100)

Total amount (A) = Principal (P) + SI

**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ A = (8)/(7) P

⇒ P + (P times R times 6)/(100) = (8)/(7) P

Dividing both sides by P:

⇒ 1 + (6R)/(100) = (8)/(7)

Solving for R:

⇒ (6R)/(100) = (8)/(7) - 1

⇒ (6R)/(100) = (1)/(7)

⇒ 6R = (100)/(7)

⇒ R = (100)/(42)

⇒ R = 2.38\% = 2(8)/(21)\%

**∴ The rate of simple interest per annum was 2(8)/(21)\%.**
